detailed_description:
The target video is a cinematic live-action-style wuxia musou combat segment in 16:9 landscape framing, with high dynamic contrast and a burning battlefield filled with flames, embers, smoke, and a sea of iron-armored enemies. This segment showcases area sweeping through starburst slash patterns: she sprints along the arms of giant glowing crosses, each pass cutting through a line of enemies while the background blurs into streaks. The camera tracks with her at her speed, always holding her in medium close-ups, close-ups, or extreme close-ups; she never appears small or distant.
[Shot 1] An extreme close-up frames the face of <Subject 1> and the crimson particle-wrapped sword edge; at 00:00.500 she drops into a low sprint; at 00:00.900 she swings the sword in a wide horizontal crescent slash, a circle of enemies flying outward, the background streaking into motion blur, the camera keeping pace beside her.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.400, the shot cuts to a medium close-up tracking her starburst cross slash: she sprints along one arm of a giant glowing cross, cutting through a line of enemies who fly apart, then sprints back along the other arm at 00:02.200, the background fully blurred and only her silhouette and the crimson slash trails staying sharp. At 00:02.800 she reverses direction and traces a second cross at a different angle, shredding another wave; at 00:03.200 enemies and debris fly in all directions.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.400, the shot cuts to a close-up tracking shot as she carves a straight corridor through the horde at a full sprint, afterimages trailing each stride, hundreds of enemies falling around her. At 00:04.200 she smashes through a wall of shields, sending them flying, and slams to a stop; at 00:04.600 a shockwave flattens the surrounding enemies outward.
[Shot 4] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a highlight close-up of <Subject 1>'s face, wind and embers sweeping past, hair whipping, firelight blazing in her eyes; at 00:05.600 crimson particles surge up the blade.
[Shot 5] At 00:06.200, the shot cuts to a close-up as she stomps the ground, a ring of fire and dust blasting the last nearby enemies away, the sword raised overhead and glowing, and the segment ends at 00:07.000.

overall_soundscape:
Roaring battlefield fire, the stampede and battle grunts of the enemy horde, pounding footfalls and rushing wind at every sprint, rapid sword slashes and fabric whips, bodies and debris flying, armor impacts, and a ground shockwave at the end.

non_diegetic_music:
War drums and taiko with epic low brass at a driving tempo, the rhythm layering over the cross-slash sweeps and cresting on the final ground shockwave.
